notes: Nordea Netbank (Finland) CSV, the same engine as Sweden's in Finnish. Semicolon-separated, unquoted, a trailing ; on every line, YYYY/MM/DD, Määrä signed with a comma decimal and no thousands mark, Valuutta EUR, newest first. This common 8-column form has no balance column, so no opening or closing. The BOM and LF are assumed from the Swedish exports of the same platform (one Finnish sample in a repo is CRLF without BOM, but it was hand-edited). Some exports carry Viesti and Saldo columns as well (columns can be chosen); this file uses the form most often seen in 2023-2024 exports.
